Callout.Name: Dog Bite
Callout.Message: Person bitten by a dog, wound to the leg.
Callout.Advisory: Conscious, dog secured by the owner, wound bleeding.
Callout.Patient: It just went for me. I did not even touch it.

Lines.Approach: Dog is secured and the owner is apologetic, which does not help the leg.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
